profile.headline: SWE @ Paxos | ex-Amazon
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Software engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and building large scale distributed systems utilizing tools like Java, AWS, and TypeScript. Proven experience in developing key features for Amazon's payment services including payment transaction processing, fraud risk assessment, and customer identification, contributing to successful Just Walk Out store launches. Currently looking for software engineering roles preferably located in NYC.

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: • Accepted as fellow out of hundreds of applicants

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
● Designed and built Java-based distributed payment systems processing millions of transactions daily with 99.99%+ availability and 97%+ success rate
● Led tier-1 payment service migrations, including NetScaler to Tardigrade, while maintaining 99.99%+ availability
● Owned end-to-end redesign of an internal data aggregation system using TypeScript and AWS services (S3, Flink, Kinesis, OpenSearch), eliminating system crashes and improving observability
● Mentored an intern to build a GenAI-powered store onboarding agent, improving onboarding efficiency by 8x

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
● Improved reliability and release velocity of payment, and fraud & abuse systems by enhancing code quality, monitoring, and CI/CD integration tests
● Supported global store launches and integrated new payment features, including Stripe and AMEX acceptance
● Led security migrations for high-throughput payment services, transitioning from AAA and legacy credential systems to AWS IAM-based authentication
● Designed and delivered MFA support for EU payment methods within a 2-month deadline to meet PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) requirements

positions.title: Fundraising Director
positions.description:
•	Oversee fundraising committee and communicate with other directors about fundraising logistics
•	Hold weekly meetings to plan and organize fundraisers to raise money for all of SWE

positions.title: Fundraising Coordinator
positions.description:
• Oversee fundraising committee members and serve as link between committee and directors
• Hold weekly meetings to plan and organize fundraisers

positions.title: Fundraising Committee Member
positions.description: • Brainstormed, promoted, and held fundraisers around campus to raise money for SWE

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Work on collaborative team of students to develop and maintain course management site used by thousands of students and
professors at Cornell
• Develop new UI using JavaScript and React

positions.title: Information Security Intern
positions.description:
● Monitored and analyzed security threats using Splunk and ThreatQ to identify potential risks
● Built dashboards to visualize log data and improve threat investigation efficiency for security analysts by 50%
● Created diagram of part of Cisco’s network to help analysts better understand how security tools work

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Collaborated with fellow intern on Chrome extension to display ownership of various apps on Fidelity website
● Developed webpage to improve user experience and customer retention using Agile methodologies
● Built full-stack state management solution using TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js APIs, and Cypress end-to-end tests

positions.title: Showcase Committee Member
positions.description: • Worked on logistics, fundraising, design, and ideas for yearly showcase
